experience.title: Graphic Designer

Utilized AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and visual exploration.

Produced product visuals and marketing assets using Photoshop and Illustrator.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
